description: Sixteen voltage sources with sixteen stored scenes in each of sixteen banks, a fader that morphs the whole set between two of those scenes, and a sequencer that can drive the morph on its own

params.text: Chooses which of the sixteen scenes that end of the morph reads from, 0 to 15
Steps that scene number up by one
Steps that scene number down by one
Jumps that scene number to a random one
Morphs between the two scenes, the bottom scene at one end of its travel and the top scene at the other
Takes the morph to the bottom scene at once, and returns every control that was moved by hand into the morph
Takes the morph to the top scene at once, and returns every control that was moved by hand into the morph
Stores the sixteen control values into that scene
Steps through the six ways the sequencer picks the next scene — forward, backward, ping-pong, random, a weighted random walk, and one that leaves both scenes alone and only turns the morph around
Drives the sequencer on one step, turning the morph around and picking the next scene
Sets how fast the automatic morph travels, and the response is steep, so most of the useful range is at the low end
Fills that scene with random values
Fills that scene with random values and randomizes the control types as well
Steps through the three ways the sequencer moves: only once the morph has reached an end, as soon as it is triggered, or on the trigger but counting jumps only after an end is reached
Sets how many scenes the sequencer runs through, 0 to 15
Sets how far along its travel one of the two Bezier control points falls, -1 to 2
Sets how high one of the two Bezier control points is taken, -5 to 5
Switches the shape the automatic morph travels between a straight line and a Bezier curve set by the four trimpots
Arms recording of control movements; it takes two round trips before it starts, flashing blue then yellow, and turns red while it records
Chooses which of the sixteen banks of scenes is in use, 0 to 15
Steps that control through its five behaviours: following the morph, jumping to the target value, sending a gate as long as its value, quantizing to the semitone, and quantizing and jumping
Sets that control's value, and moving it takes the control out of the morph until the morph button is clicked again
Switches that control's output between 0V to 10V and -5V to +5V, except on the quantized behaviours, where it runs -4V to +6V

inputs.text: 0V to 10V chooses the scene at that end of the morph, added to its selector
Added to the morph fader, taking it across its whole travel
A trigger here steps that scene number up by one
A trigger here steps that scene number down by one
A trigger here jumps that scene number to a random one
Volts here move one of the two Bezier control points along its travel
Volts here move one of the two Bezier control points up and down
0V to 10V adds 0 to 15 to the bank number
Volts here are added to the morph speed, 10V being its whole range
A trigger here takes the morph to the bottom scene
A trigger here takes the morph to the top scene
A trigger here drives the sequencer on one step
A trigger here sends the sequencer back to the first scene, on the forward mode only

outputs.text: That control's voltage, in whichever range and behaviour it has been set to

menu: Randomize top scene only — fills the scene the top selector points at with random values and randomizes the control types with them, leaving the other scenes alone
Copy bank (over+C) — copies the whole bank of sixteen scenes; holding the pointer over the BANK knob and pressing C does the same
Paste bank (over+V) — pastes the copied bank over the bank in use
Show/Hide masking tape — shows or hides the sixteen label strips drawn over the controls
Toggle override types — flips all sixteen controls between holding a hand-moved value when the scene changes and letting it go back into the morph
Label 0 to Label 15 — sixteen text fields, one per control, naming it on the masking tape
Ramp Up — on a control knob's own menu, writes a rising ramp into that control across the scenes the LENGTH knob covers
Ramp Down — on a control knob's own menu, writes a falling ramp into that control across the scenes the LENGTH knob covers
Sinus — on a control knob's own menu, writes half a sine into that control across the scenes the LENGTH knob covers
Randomize — on a control knob's own menu, gives that control a random value in all sixteen scenes of the bank
Init — on a control knob's own menu, sets that control to zero in the scenes the LENGTH knob covers
Const. override — on a control knob's own menu, keeps that control's hand-moved value when the scene changes, with a tick while it is on
Root note — on a control knob's own menu, a submenu setting the root note that control is quantized to on its quantizing behaviours
Scale — on a control knob's own menu, a submenu setting the scale that control is quantized to on its quantizing behaviours
Copy scene (over+C) — on either scene selector's own menu, copies the scene that selector points at; holding the pointer over the selector and pressing C does the same
Paste scene (over+V) — on either scene selector's own menu, pastes the copied scene over the one that selector points at

inputs.18: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
